presentation.label: Constipation
presentation.free_text_prompt: Tell us more about the constipation.  You may want to say if this is a new problem or ongoing for a while and what treatments you have tried already
pre_form_information: If you haven't tried any treatments yet, the pharmacy can provide laxatives without having to go through the GP

questions.question: Have you been opening your bowels less often than usual?
Have your stools been hard or difficult to pass?
Have you had any abdominal discomfort or bloating?
